prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, game sprite atlas. Generate a NEW expanded black-and-white environment tileset for CreatureGathererFX, matching the bold chunky white silhouettes/black cutouts of INPUT2 creature sprites and INPUT1 environment redraw. These images are STYLE REFERENCES, not layout to copy. Output a square atlas with precisely16 columns and16 rows of equal 16x16 logical-pixel tiles, 256x256 logical canvas shown at4x to1024x1024. Strict black/white only, no grays or antialiasing. No grid lines, labels, margins or gutters: flush-to-edge aligned cells. Design actual simple tile shapes on16x16 pixels; large shadows, sparse clean texture, rounded organic plants, readable tiny props; no stipple. TOP HALF: eight rows of16 independent environment tiles. In every row: col0 repeatable quiet walkable ground, col1 repeatable path ground, col2 repeatable dark water with sparse horizontal white ripple, col3 solid rock/wall tile. Cols4-15 isolated centered environmental props on consistent LIGHT ground. Row0 meadow: grass, dirt, pond water, boulder, flower patches, berry bushes, saplings, small stones, fences, trail marker, well, leaf pile, mushrooms, stump, seed plants, log. Row1 woodland: quiet leaf ground, forest path, stream, dark tree trunk, rounded broadleaf trees, conifers, mushrooms, logs, stumps, acorns, fern, signpost, bee nest, hollow tree, berry bush, fallen branch. Row2 coastline: pale sand, sand path, sea water, crag, shells, driftwood, beach grass, palm, pier post, fishing rack, rowboat, tidepool, crab rock, coral, anchor, buoy. Row3 marsh: quiet muddy ground, plank path, dark pond, mossy rock, reeds, cattails, lily pads, willow, mushroom, marsh berries, fallen log, plank bridge, bog stump, flower, pond stone, signpost. Row4 mountain: quiet gravel, stone path, mountain lake, angular cliff, boulders, crystals, ore outcrop, scree, cairn, pine, cave arch, ledge, broken cart, signpost, snow patch, quarry block. Row5 snow: clean snow, tracks, ice water, frozen cliff, snowy pine, ice crystal, snowdrift, frozen bush, bare tree, icicle rock, cairn, log, sled, stone, fence, shelter post. Row6 village: clean lawn, cobblestone path, canal, brick wall, fence, flowerbed, well, barrel, crate, market awning, bench, lamp, cart, sign, woodpile, small vegetable plot. Row7 ruins: clean worn stone, broken paving, dark fountain water, ruined wall, broken column, arch, statue, rubble, vines, chest, gravestone, carved stone, broken door, mosaic, urn, crystal. Terrain patterns should tile calmly, no heavy border frames.
BOTTOM HALF must be MULTI-TILE ASSEMBLIES, NOT individual mini-icons. Rows8-11: FOUR separate64x64 logical-pixel exteriors, each exactly4x4tiles: cols0-3 welcoming cottage with chunky roof, window and centered door; cols4-7 woodland cabin with broad timber shapes; cols8-11 village shop with awning and door; cols12-15 ancient stone tower with entrance. Footprints and scale exactly fit each64px block, exterior ground white. Rows12-15: FOUR64x64 top-down interior rooms corresponding columns0-3 cottage room with bed table shelves and clear floor; cols4-7 shop room with counter shelves crates and clear floor; cols8-11 ruined shrine with columns altar and clear central route; cols12-15 cave with dark rock perimeter crystals and clear pale central path. Each interior exactly4x4tiles; no perspective camera, simple top-down RPG framing. Buildings and interior sections should have aligned16px internal seams. All tile cells equally spaced. DO NOT insert characters, creatures, text, grid overlays, UI, frame, or colors. Only final square sprite atlas.
status: Review only. Native16x16 cells are crops; generated subjects may span or drift across those cells.
